newsitem.title: UK: Reuters down as NatWest trims forecasts. [CORRECTED 11:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Reuters down as NatWest trims forecasts. [CORRECTED 11:50 GMT]

text.p: Shares in Reuters Holdings Plc dropped on Monday as NatWest Securities lowered its earnings estimates for the news and financial information group, traders said.
The stock was down 8p at 745-1/2 by 0959 GMT, after falling as low as 744p -- its lowest since the start of October. Trading volume was a modest 194,210 shares.

Market sources said NatWest cut its 1997 estimate, (corrects from "current-year estimate") for Reuters pre-tax profit to 785 million stg from 806 million and its 1998 (corrects from 1997) estimate to 915 million stg from 931 million.
Reasons for the downgrade were not immediately available and NatWest analysts were not immediately available for comment.
The brokerage repeated an "add" recommendation on Reuters shares, (corrects from a "hold" recommendation).
